Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting/configure-notifications/manage-contact-points/integrations/webhook-notifier

Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for dashboard/alerting docs agents need: webhook notifier

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json

Rules:
